messages:
Lena: quick ping — after today's console deploy some users saw saved dashboard filters from other orgs show up in the widgets list
Omar: repro steps?
Lena: login -> quick-switch org -> Dashboards -> Saved Filters dropdown; intermittently shows filters with tag `org:acme` while I'm in `org:globex`
Priya: any customer reports or just QA?
Lena: QA and one internal demo user. Not public but treat as high risk.
Jules: FYI we rolled websocket routing change earlier to dedupe subscriptions by user_id to cut open sockets.
infra-bot: deploy 3.2.1-feature/ws-subscriptions -> web-console-canary completed at 1795609500 :rocket:
Omar: that dedupe sounds dangerous if keying only on user_id. Two org sessions for same user could collapse. We should be keying on `user_id+org_id`
Priya: confirmed in the code: cache key is `ws_subs:user:<id>` (no org). Server can hand back persisted subscription objects created under a different org.
Lena: widgets reuse subscription metadata to build the Saved Filters dropdown so that would explain the leak.
Jules: proposed fixes: 1) change ws cache key to include org; 2) store `org_id` on subscription entries and ignore mismatches at read; 3) run a short migration to TTL ambiguous entries
Priya: also add a runtime guard: if a filter/item is returned where `item.org != request.org` then hide it and emit an audit log/event
Omar: agree. Add telemetry: metric for `console.cross_org_filter_count` and alert if >0.01% of requests in 5m window -> page SRE
Lena: customer impact seems limited so far, but we should also scan last 24h for exposures and prepare CS notification if found
support-bot: CS ticket template created: support/console-filter-exposure (use if scan shows customer data)
Jules: temp mitigation = rollback the websocket dedupe on canary groups until fix lands
infra-bot: rollback 3.2.1-feature/ws-subscriptions from web-console-canary initiated at 1795610200
infra-bot: rollback completed at 1795610305 :white_check_mark:
Priya: I'll open a PR with the key change + unit tests that simulate rapid org-switch and subscription churn. Will also add an integration canary test that spins up two org contexts for same user.
Omar: add a CI gating test to the canary pipeline so future pushes can't roll without that check
Lena: I'll run a one-off telemetry scan and share any affected session ids here
Priya: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/4620
Lena: thanks. Marking incident Sev=high, pausing canaries for websocket changes until gating tests and audit telemetry exist. Postmortem after fix is validated.
Omar: noted. Keep updates in this thread.
Lena: will post scan results and sample JSONs when available.
